recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a wrapper script on edna that sends an alert when nightly-sync exits with an error, plus a ping to one hosted dead-man check that notifies the user if no success has been reported by 04:00.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need to know by morning if nightly-sync did not succeed (from your 4 day silent failure).
labels.Deleted: central log on Synology, Docker for nightly-sync, dashboard you have to open.
labels.Bottleneck: missing success signal gets no alert, not log storage or location.
labels.Checked myself: cron 03:00 on edna emails only on finish, 4 startup crashes on expired token sent nothing, no other alert today, you said you will not read logs.

note: Classed LARGER, but it is a close call: the wrapper sends its own failure alert, apparently by email ('reuses an alert you already read'), and the hosted dead-man check is a second alert, so that is two separate alerting mechanisms.
